verdict.rationale: Base44 is a managed, hosted app-building platform; evidence shows only that you can eject/clone individual apps you built on Base44 into local code (still requiring Base44's backend/app ID) or use the SDK/CLI against Base44's managed backend — nothing indicates the core Base44 platform (the AI builder, orchestration, or backend infrastructure itself) can be self-hosted on one's own servers. Missing for 10: any documentation of an open-source release or self-hosted deployment option for the core Base44 service itself.
